q: Ravi alone can complete a job in 10 days and Suresh alone can complete it in 15 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
e: Combined work per day = 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6, so they take 6 days.

q: Money lent at simple interest grows to triple the principal over a period of 10 years. Find the annual interest rate.
e: Interest = 2 × principal in 10 years, so rate = 200/10 = 20%.

q: The total surface area of a cube is 150 cm². What is its volume?
e: 6a² = 150 gives a = 5 cm, so volume = 5³ = 125 cm³.

q: A 60-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio 5 : 1. How many litres of water must be added to make the ratio 5 : 3?
e: Milk = 50 L, water = 10 L. For 5 : 3, water must be 30 L, so add 20 litres.

q: Which letter comes next in the series: B, E, H, K, ?
e: Each letter is 3 places after the previous one: K + 3 = N.

q: If 15 August of a certain year falls on a Monday, on which day of the week will 15 September of the same year fall?
e: August has 31 days; 31 = 4 weeks + 3 days, so Monday + 3 = Thursday.

q: In macroeconomics, the "crowding out" effect refers to:
o: A fall in private investment caused by increased government borrowing
A rise in exports caused by currency depreciation
A fall in prices caused by excess supply of goods
A rise in savings caused by higher income tax
e: Government borrowing raises interest rates and reduces private investment; that is crowding out.

q: Choose the correct collective noun: A ___ of lions.
e: A group of lions is called a pride.

q: Identify the figure of speech in the sentence: "The wind whispered through the trees."
e: Giving the human action of whispering to the wind is personification.

q: In which year did the Indian National Congress launch the Quit India Movement?
e: The Quit India Movement was launched in August 1942.

q: Which Constitutional Amendment Act lowered the voting age in India from 21 years to 18 years?
e: The 61st Amendment Act, 1988 reduced the voting age from 21 to 18 years.

q: In Microsoft Excel, a formula entered in a cell must begin with which symbol?
e: Every Excel formula starts with the equals sign (=).

q: Which type of lens is used in spectacles to correct myopia (short-sightedness)?
e: Myopia is corrected with a diverging, i.e. concave, lens.
